title: Great Soup
description: This mod is focused on adding soups with various effects. It also adds bosses, new mechanics, biomes, and glue, but the most important thing is the soups.
body: The Great Soup mod adds many new soups to the game, ranging from useful plant-based and sea soups that give regeneration, water breathing, or faster swimming, to more exotic and risky recipes like Zoup or hot soup, which can be used as a ranged weapon that sets enemies on fire. Alongside soups, the mod also adds other content such as the unique Noobland biome, featuring its own type of soup, new blocks, and a boss. JEI recommended.
